UAT-MOE-01.title: Prepare EA, school, student and publish fees
UAT-MOE-01.setup:
Setup:
1. Government API mock has a Singapore citizen who has just turned 7
2. MOE HQ User account exists
3. Fee Type, Fee Component and Rate are configured
Data:
Student: student.test01, NRIC S0000001A
School: School Test 01
Class: P1A
Fee: Tuition fee 100.00 SGD
Gate: UAT environment is ready and the data above is created. Severity 1: must Pass before go live
UAT-MOE-01.steps:
Steps:
1. Run the daily sync job
2. Log in to the Admin Portal as MOE HQ User, create a School and a School User
3. Log in as the School User, create the class, enter the student and assign the student to the class
4. Log in as MOE HQ User, create a Fee Publication for that school and publish it
5. Open the student's Student Charge
Expected:
1. An Active EA is created for the student with balance 0.00
2. The student is linked to the EA after class assignment
3. Student Charge is POSTED and visible to the parent

Budget Amount: 1000000.00

UAT-MOE-04.steps:

2. Enter the Budget Amount
3. Click Save
4. Reopen the budget view
Expected:
1. The budget is saved
2. The view shows the saved Budget Amount within MOEFAS scope

UAT-MOE-05.title: Track MOEFAS statistics and budget usage
UAT-MOE-05.setup:

2. Some MOEFAS subsidies are already granted

2. Check Total Subsidy Amount Granted
3. Open the Budget Tracking page
Expected:
1. Total granted subsidy is correct for MOEFAS scope

UAT-SCH-01.title: Enter a parent's paper application
UAT-SCH-01.setup:
Setup:
1. School User is logged in

4. A PDF scan under 10 MB is available

File: paper-form-test01.pdf
Applicant NRIC: S0000100A
Child NRIC: S0000001A
Relationship: Mother
Context: Household income reduced
Gate: UAT environment is ready and the data above is created. Severity 1: must Pass before go live
UAT-SCH-01.steps:
Steps:
1. Open Upload applications, click Upload scans, add the file, click Upload and read
2. Enter the applicant's NRIC and the child's NRIC

2. Income comes from Government data and GHI and PCI are shown

UAT-SCH-02.title: Create an SBFAS scheme and add a fee
UAT-SCH-02.setup:
Setup:
1. School Admin is logged in

Name: Tier 1
Nationality: Singapore Citizen
Subsidy: P1 100%, P2 80%, P3 60%

UAT-SCH-03.title: Approve an SBFAS application
UAT-SCH-03.setup:

2. The application becomes Approved with the tier and the scheme Effective from

UAT-PAR-01.title: Log in, view the EA and pay fees with the EA
UAT-PAR-01.setup:
Setup:
1. Parent has a SingPass mock account and a child under 16 linked to an EA
2. The Active EA has balance 100.00
3. The child has one Issued invoice of 50.00
Data:
Parent: parent.test01, NRIC S0000100A
Child: student.test01, EA code EA-001
Invoice: 50.00
Gate: UAT environment is ready and the data above is created. Severity 1: must Pass before go live
UAT-PAR-01.steps:
Steps:
1. Open e-Service and click Log in with SingPass
2. On Home choose the child Edu Account card
3. On Edu Account Detail choose Pay fees
4. Choose the invoice
5. Choose to pay with the EA and confirm
6. Open the receipt
Expected:
1. Home shows a card with the child name, EA code and balance
2. The fee list belongs to the selected child, with no need to choose the student again
3. The EA is debited 50.00 exactly once, leaving 50.00
4. The invoice becomes Paid and the receipt shows invoice code, total, method and amount per source
5. The receipt has a way back to the correct child

UAT-PAR-01-A1.title: Split between EA and online
UAT-PAR-01-A1.setup:
Setup:
1. Parent is logged in
2. EA balance is 20.00
3. The child has an Issued invoice of 50.00
4. The Online sandbox gateway is set to succeed
Data:
EA part: 20.00
Online part: 30.00
Gate: Shares data and environment with UAT-PAR-01. Severity 1: must Pass before go live
UAT-PAR-01-A1.steps:
Steps:
1. Go to the child's fees and choose the invoice
2. Choose Both and confirm
3. Complete payment on the Online gateway
4. Open the receipt
Expected:
1. The EA part equals the whole balance and the Online part is the remainder
2. The EA is debited first, then the Online gateway opens
3. The invoice is Paid and the receipt lists both sources, total 50.00
4. The EA balance is 0.00

UAT-PAR-01-N4.title: Online part fails

Online part: 30.00

UAT-PAR-01-N4.steps:
Steps:
1. Choose Both and confirm
2. At the Online gateway choose failure or cancel
3. Return to e-Service and open the invoice
Expected:
1. The EA part of 20.00 is refunded
2. The invoice returns to Issued and can be retried
3. The EA balance returns to 20.00

UAT-PAR-01-E2.title: EA refund fails

EA part: 20.00
Online part: 30.00

UAT-PAR-01-E2.steps:

1. Choose Both and confirm
2. At the Online gateway choose failure
3. Open the invoice after the refund command fails
Expected:
1. The transaction moves to ReconciliationRequired and the invoice stays PaymentPending
2. The parent sees a verifying status
3. An alert is raised for operations

UAT-PAR-02.title: Submit an online FAS application, MOEFAS auto approves after the form closes
UAT-PAR-02.setup:
Setup:

Data:
Relationship: Mother
Context: Household income reduced
Form closes: 31 Dec 2028
Gate: UAT environment is ready and the data above is created. Severity 1: must Pass before go live
UAT-PAR-02.steps:
Steps:
1. On Home go to Financial assistance and click Apply for FAS
2. Step 1: choose the relationship and the child, click Continue
3. Step 2: check members and income, click Continue
4. Step 3: skip documents, keep the tick to also consider SBFAS, click Continue
5. Step 4: enter context, click Continue
6. Step 5: review, tick the declaration, click Submit application
7. Open My applications, then open it again after the MOEFAS form closes
Expected:
1. Parent details are prefilled and read only
2. Income comes from Government data and GHI, household size and PCI are shown
3. The message Application submitted for assessment appears
4. The application is Under review with System check Waiting and the form close date
5. After the form closes the application is Approved MOEFAS from the scheme Effective from
